snippet.description:
How can you forgive the unforgivable?

Subscribe to our channel! http://goo.gl/0bsAjO

In 2012, journalist Michael Scott Moore was kidnapped by Somali pirates and held hostage for 977 days. In this episode of The Gray Area, guest host Sally Herships speaks with Michael about the complex emotional journey following his captivity:  how he navigated a desire for revenge, a longing for justice, and the decision to find forgiveness. 

Host: Sally Herships, journalist and director of the audio program at Columbia University's Graduate School of Journalism.
Guest: Michael Scott Moore, author The Desert and the Sea

00:00 Intro
01:44 Life in captivity 
03:55 The seeds of forgiveness
07:11 Meet the Somali pirates
21:20 The Somali pirates and their agenda 
34:14 U.S. Justice, legal consequences, and cooperation 
42:22 Reflections on forgiveness and moving forward

We would love to hear from you. To tell us what you thought of this episode, email us at thegrayarea@vox.com or leave us a voicemail at 1-800-214-5749. Your comments and questions help us make a better show.

And you can watch new episodes of The Gray Area on YouTube. New episodes drop every Monday and Friday.
